forAuthors.title: Information for Authors
forAuthors.subtitle: Guidelines, formatting requirements, and instructions for preparing a blind submission.
forAuthors.guidelinesIntro: The journal considers original, unpublished scholarship written in English, French, or Arabic. Manuscripts must adhere to the following standards:
forAuthors.guideline1: Length between 6,000 and 10,000 words inclusive of footnotes and references.
forAuthors.guideline2: Structured trilingual abstract (150–250 words) and 5–8 keywords.
forAuthors.guideline3: References formatted according to the Chicago Manual of Style (Notes & Bibliography) or APA 7th Edition.
forAuthors.guideline4: Manuscript submitted exclusively in PDF format without embedded author metadata.
forAuthors.anonymizationIntro: To ensure impartial evaluation, all submissions undergo double-blind peer review. Authors are strictly responsible for removing identifying markers:
forAuthors.anonItem1: Omit author names, institutional affiliations, and acknowledgments from the manuscript file.
forAuthors.anonItem2: Refer to prior publications in the third person (e.g. 'as previously argued in [Author, 2021]' rather than 'in our previous work').
forAuthors.anonItem3: Clear file properties and metadata in your PDF export (File → Properties in Adobe Acrobat or Word).
forAuthors.step1Desc: The Editor-in-Chief assesses scope conformity, originality, and adherence to anonymization requirements within 7 business days.
forAuthors.step2Desc: Two independent subject experts evaluate originality, methodology, clarity, significance, and relevance.
forAuthors.step3Desc: Authors receive an editorial decision notice accompanied by anonymized feedback and recommendations.
forAuthors.step4Desc: Accepted manuscripts undergo copyediting, typesetting, DOI assignment, and final author proofing.
forAuthors.faq1Q: Are there any Article Processing Charges (APCs)?
forAuthors.faq1A: No. The journal is fully Diamond Open Access; there are zero fees for submission, processing, or open-access publication.
forAuthors.faq2Q: Can I submit in Arabic or French?
forAuthors.faq2A: Yes. We accept manuscripts in English, French, and Arabic with equal editorial and peer-review standing.
forAuthors.faq3Q: How long does the review process take?
forAuthors.faq3A: Initial editorial triage takes approximately 1 to 2 weeks. The full double-blind review process averages 6 to 8 weeks.
forAuthors.checkItem2: Complete anonymity in body text and metadata
forAuthors.checkItem3: Abstract in manuscript language and English
forAuthors.checkItem4: Author metadata verified before final submission
forAuthors.quickHelpText: Our editorial office is available to assist with formatting or portal questions.

about.title: About the Journal
about.subtitle: Mission, governance, peer-review standards, and open-access commitment.
about.peerReviewBody: Every submission is evaluated through a strict double-blind protocol where neither authors nor reviewers possess knowledge of each other's identity.
about.openAccessBody: All articles are immediately available worldwide upon publication under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial (CC BY-NC 4.0) license.
about.publishingBody: Published biannually by University Scholarly Press. Long-term digital preservation is maintained through CLOCKSS and PKP Preservation Network.
about.peerReviewNote: The editorial office guarantees that all manuscripts sent for external assessment have identifying characteristics removed. Reviewers evaluate manuscripts according to rigorous criteria of originality, methodological depth, conceptual clarity, and scholarly contribution.
about.openAccessNote: Authors retain copyright and grant the journal right of first publication with the work simultaneously licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial (CC BY-NC 4.0) license. There are never submission fees or article processing charges (APCs).

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.subtitle: Our commitment to digital inclusion, keyboard navigation, and WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.body1: The Journal platform is designed to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA requirements.
accessibility.body2: We believe scholarly literature should be accessible to all researchers, practitioners, and students. This platform is designed and continuously tested according to the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.
accessibility.feature1: Complete keyboard navigation support throughout all public pages and portals.
accessibility.feature2: High-contrast typography with AA compliance on ink-on-paper color scales.
accessibility.feature3: Full bidirectional RTL layout support with semantic text mirroring for Arabic.
accessibility.feedbackBody: If you encounter any accessibility barriers, please contact our accessibility team at accessibility@journal.university.example.
